PLAN "12-week General Strength — Post L4-L5 Herniation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "General strength with spinal-safe progressions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper stability":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower & core (spine-safe)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x1m rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Posterior chain & conditioning":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          back_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walk 10m rpe 4
        cooldown:
